prerequisite: A true all-three-corner positive control among the fixed local_v4 twelve ideal OP/AC calls; select the first declared passing bias only after all twelve calls finish

transient.relative_error_definition: The maximum absolute output deviation from its corresponding final-plateau mean, divided by the absolute measured high-minus-low plateau difference; no absolute DC tracking precision is implied
transient.incremental_gain_definition: (mean(output in high plateau)-mean(output in low plateau))/0.02V

dc.incremental_gain_definition: Every adjacent output difference divided by the corresponding 0.05V input difference; all five output samples must be finite and inside the original 0.7..1.2V headroom window
dc.interpretation: Five sampled closed-loop transfer points, not proof of continuous rail-to-rail swing

power_accounting: Use actual VDD/VBN/VBP source currents. The VDD-to-IBIAS reference branch is already included in VDD power. Ideal external bias generator implementation overhead is outside this declared fixture and remains disclosed.
completeness: Every requested OP/AC/Tran/DC table and ngspice log must pass the exact declared analysis coverage. Timeout, partial trace, missing per-finger binding, or software exceptions are unknown, not a candidate-negative label.
